_comment: Corpora indexed by STAR Knowledge. Licences were read from each repository's licence files (Roblox/Luau on 2026-10-10; the knowledge-school sources on 2026-10-18, see docs/agents/knowledge-school-20261018.md). Only sources whose licence permits local copying are listed. `group` decides the search scope: a Roblox or Luau question is answered from the `roblox` group only (search.auto_scope). Sources with a `walker` use starkb/walkers.py; `checkout` names the shared Git checkout under sources/; `kind: files` sources are fetched by starkb/fetch_pages.py (SNAPSHOT.json instead of a commit). `{commit}` in public_base is replaced by the indexed commit.
